title: Broadcast Locally
symptom: The user enabled 'Broadcast locally' in xDrip but their app does not receive any broadcast, while a system broadcast works.
cause: The user's intent filter was configured with only the name of the xDrip package, missing the correct action name required for the broadcast.
fix: The user added a filter with the correct name from the xDrip source code to configure the intent filter properly, after which the broadcast was received.
evidence_quote: To receive the broadcast from xDrip, I have add a filter but only with the name of the xDrip package. In the source code I find the correcte name to configure correctely my intent filter. Now that works fine :-)
